qualifier: receptor-independent, including oncogenic constitutive PI3K
name: PI3K/AKT signal activation, including oncogenic constitutive PI3K
rationale: All members concern positive or constitutive PI3K/AKT signaling, whereas the confusables are PI3K cascades downstream of specific receptors (FGFR, MET, ALK/LTK) or ERK signaling.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
name: Antigen presentation featuring CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members are antigen presentation sets marked by CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and the TLR7/TLR8 cluster, unlike confusables centred on MHC class II peptide presentation or monocyte/DC surface signatures.

qualifier: CDC42-subfamily and atypical RND/RHOD GTPases
name: CDC42-family and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and effectors (formins, IQGAPs, microvilli) of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD and RND2/3, while confusables carry the RHOA/B/C and RAC cycles and their ROCK/PAK/WAVE effectors.

core: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and kinetochore attachment
qualifier: with spindle midzone assembly and elongation
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment and midzone assembly
rationale: Members regulate the spindle assembly checkpoint (MAD2), kinetochore-microtubule attachment and anaphase spindle midzone/elongation, distinct from confusables on PLK1/Aurora/NEK mitotic entry or cytokinesis.

qualifier: endothelial activation and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion
name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, vascular wound healing and vessel remodeling/angiogenesis, whereas confusables focus on smooth muscle migration, monocyte activation or VEGF/FGF production.

qualifier: hypertrophic cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization
name: Cardiac muscle adaptation and hypertrophic cardiomyocyte growth
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization, unlike confusables on skeletal muscle atrophy/fiber switching, calcineurin signaling or heart contractility.

qualifier: BAX/BAK effector oligomerization and cytochrome c release
name: BAX/BAK-mediated mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and cytochrome c release
rationale: Members cover BAX/BAK activation, BH3-only neutralization of anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins, MOMP and cytochrome c release, whereas confusables add individual BH3-only activation steps or downstream apoptosome/SMAC events.

core: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism
qualifier: ammonium homeostasis
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, ammonium homeostasis
rationale: Members span glutamate, glutamine, proline, ornithine, arginine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium/nitrogen handling, lacking the core urea cycle enzyme defects, cationic amino acid transport and glyoxylate/2-oxoglutarate sets of the confusables.

qualifier: regulated by KIR and MHC class I recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity and its MHC class I-KIR regulation
rationale: Members concern NK cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and inhibition including KIR, protection from NK killing and MHC class I/Ib presentation, unlike confusables centred on T cell activation/proliferation or DC-mediated T cell tolerance.

qualifier: on O-GalNAc and complex N-glycans and gangliosides
name: Golgi glycan elongation and sialylation on glycoproteins and gangliosides
rationale: Members cover mucin-type O-glycan and complex/hybrid N-glycan elongation, sialic acid metabolism, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, whereas confusables cover early N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport or fucosylation and blood groups.

qualifier: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase chain-shortening steps from palmitoyl- to octanoyl-CoA
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation spiral from palmitoyl- to octanoyl-CoA
rationale: All members are acyl-CoA dehydrogenase-driven mitochondrial beta-oxidation cycles of long and medium chains, while confusables carry the carnitine shuttle, ketone body metabolism or peroxisomal oxidation.

qualifier: deoxyribonucleosides and dGMP/dCMP
name: Deoxyribonucleotide and deoxyribonucleoside breakdown
rationale: Members are catabolism/turnover of deoxyribonucleosides and deoxynucleoside monophosphates, unlike confusables on deoxynucleotide biosynthesis/salvage or ribonucleotide purine and pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: myocardial wall maturation, septation and endocardium
name: Myocardial wall maturation, septation and endocardial development
rationale: Members concern ventricular trabeculation and compaction, cardiac septum, endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis, whereas confusables cover early heart tube, second heart field, valves and cushions.

qualifier: ATF6 and CREB3 transcription factor arm
name: ER unfolded protein response via ATF6 and CREB3 factors
rationale: Members center on ATF6/ATF6B/CREB3 chaperone gene activation plus regulation of IRE1/PERK branches and ER-stress apoptosis, whereas confusables carry the ATF4/eIF2alpha translational and XBP1 arms.

qualifier: NODAL regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Left-right asymmetry establishment by NODAL and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members are left/right axis and organ asymmetry plus NODAL inhibition and extracellular BMP/ligand sequestration, distinct from confusables on gastrulation, planar cell polarity, motile cilium assembly or somitogenesis.

qualifier: pseudouridylation, methylation and wobble modification
name: tRNA aminoacylation and RNA pseudouridylation, methylation and wobble modification
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging plus tRNA/mRNA/rRNA pseudouridylation, methylation and wobble modifications, unlike confusables on wybutosine, t6A, tRNA processing or mitochondrial tRNA processing.

qualifier: under NRF2 and p53 control
name: NADPH regeneration and redox metabolism under NRF2 and p53 control
rationale: Members link pentose phosphate, isocitrate and NADPH regeneration, NRF2/p53 metabolic gene regulation, mTORC1, ROS and ferroptosis suppression, whereas confusables emphasize hypoxia/glycolysis, broader NRF2 targets or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: APP metabolism, tau tangles and microglial activation
name: Alzheimer-related control of APP metabolism, tau tangles and microglia
rationale: Members regulate amyloid precursor protein synthesis and catabolism, neurofibrillary tangles and microglial activation, whereas confusables concern amyloid-beta clearance, astrocyte activation or amyloid fibril formation.

qualifier: by the norepinephrine transporter
name: Norepinephrine reuptake by the norepinephrine transporter
rationale: All members concern norepinephrine transport by SLC6A2, unlike confusables on serotonin, dopamine, adrenergic receptor signaling or GABA transport.

qualifier: PTEN control including ceRNA/lncRNA regulation
name: PTEN-mediated restraint of PI3K/AKT signaling, including ceRNA control
rationale: Members concern PTEN loss, localization and ceRNA/lncRNA translational control, negative PI3K/AKT and IGF receptor regulation and AKT targets, while confusables cover inositol phosphate synthesis, PTEN stability or ERBB2/3 downregulation.

qualifier: with cilium assembly and disassembly control
name: Intraflagellar transport and cilium assembly-disassembly control
rationale: Members are anterograde/retrograde intraciliary transport and regulation of cilium assembly, disassembly and centriole elongation, unlike confusables on basal body anchoring, centrosome duplication or ciliary cargo targeting.

qualifier: with carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation with carnitine shuttle and ketone bodies
rationale: Members cover the full mitochondrial beta-oxidation spiral, carnitine shuttle and ketone body synthesis/use, whereas confusables carry carnitine transport defects, peroxisomal and alpha-oxidation or malonyl-CoA metabolism.

qualifier: adipocyte triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation and fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation and adipogenesis/leptin, whereas confusables emphasize lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride catabolism.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin-mediated
name: Aquaglyceroporin-mediated glycerol and urea transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are glycerol and urea membrane transport including aquaporin glycerol export from adipocytes, unlike confusables on vasopressin water reabsorption, glycerol metabolism or fatty acid transport.

name: GABA synthesis, secretion, reuptake and degradation
rationale: All members cover the GABA life cycle from synthesis through release, reuptake and degradation, while confusables concern glutamate/glycine transport, lysine catabolism or vesicular neurotransmitter loading.
